summary: Iteration 14: validated the NEW Lottery Jackpot flow with manual winner pre-selection. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (covering create-open draw, /select-winners validations [non-participant, count mismatch, duplicate user, incomplete ranks], /launch blocked without preset, /launch succeeds after preset, /select-winners refused after launch, join refused if running, stats, full E2E preset→winners→balance credit). Frontend: UI flow validated end-to-end — '🎯 Sélectionner les gagnants' button renders on open draws with participants_count > 0, picker modal opens with all expected testIDs (winner-picker-modal, participants-list, participant-row-{uid}, winner-picker-rank-{r}, winner-pick-{r}-{uid}, winner-prize-{r}), '🚀 Lancer le tirage' clicked WITHOUT preset triggers French alert and does NOT open the launch modal, submit triggers confirm dialog, preset_winners block ('🎯 Gagnants pré-sélectionnés (publication automatique à la fin du compte à rebours)') is rendered on the draw card for previously-validated draws.
critical_code_review_comments: lottery.py is 827 lines — split between admin routes / public routes / helpers (_auto_complete_if_due) is overdue. The 700-line guideline was breached this iteration.

_auto_complete_if_due still has a random-pick fallback branch (lines 120-141) when preset_winners is empty. Since /launch now strictly enforces a non-empty preset, this branch should only fire for legacy/edge cases. Consider logging a warning when this fallback executes to surface unexpected uses.

validateWinners in lottery.tsx uses window.confirm() which is blocking and not great for testability/UX. Consider replacing with an in-app confirmation modal — also makes it easier to write Playwright tests without dialog handlers.

Launch button uses inline opacity 0.5 style with onPress alert when preset is incomplete, which is good UX, but disabled prop is not set; consider also setting `disabled` so the button cannot be focused/clicked at all from keyboard.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_lottery_jackpot_flow.py (rewritten to cover the new manual-winner-selection flow — all old tests that launched without preset_winners are updated to first call /select-winners)
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted draw TEST_UI_PICK_970aba via API for UI test (cleaned up at end). E2E test TestE2EPresetWinners creates a TEST_Jackpot_* draw that auto-announces — cannot be deleted (announced draws are immutable by API).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New Lottery flow: create (open) → users join → admin POST /api/admin/lottery/draws/{id}/select-winners {winners:[{rank,user_id,prize}]} → admin POST /api/admin/lottery/draws/{id}/launch {duration_minutes} → countdown → auto-publication of preset_winners (no random) → balance_profit credit + commission kind=lottery_win. The /select-winners endpoint enforces: status==open, len==winners_count, ranks cover 1..N, no duplicate user, all user_ids must be participants. /launch enforces: len(preset_winners)==winners_count. _auto_complete_if_due uses preset_winners directly; random fallback only kicks in if preset is empty (legacy). UI: picker modal grays out (opacity 0.35) participants already chosen on other ranks. Existing pytests in test_lottery_jackpot_flow.py now ALWAYS call /select-winners before /launch — same pattern needed for any future tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs identified. Flow works as designed and is fully covered by automated tests.
